LESSON: ULUM AL-HADITH HADITH COMPILATION OF HADITH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why was it important to collect and compile Hadith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance
2. describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhaif) to differentiate between authentic and unauthentic Hadith
3. explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhaif) to differentiate between authentic and unauthentic Hadith
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhaif) to differentiate between authentic and unauthentic Hadith. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity
   In simple words: practise until you can explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith in the examples.
2. Explain Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
4. Show that you can: identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the reasons for the classification of Hadith in groups and make notes,
2. Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication is enhanced as learners search for the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan and dhaif) and present in class.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was it important to collect and compile Hadith?
2. Why is Hadith classified?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance
2. describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhaif) to differentiate between authentic and unauthentic Hadith
3. explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
